liamwynne.erd-studio/heartbeat.comment: One anonymous usage summary per UTC day, sent after the day ends. During an install's first week, the 7 days after a major ERD Studio update (such as 1.x to 2.x), or on a day something went wrong, an interim copy of the same summary may also be sent that day (at most three); the final one replaces it. Turning telemetry off stops any further sends; an interim copy already sent that day stays. No names, paths, file contents or error text. Raw rows are deleted after 90 days.

installId.comment: Random UUID v4 minted by the extension once per VS Code profile and kept (until 1.6.2 it was replaced every 30 days). Not vscode.env.machineId and not derived from anything about the machine or user.

day.comment: The UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) the counts describe.

extVersion.comment: ERD Studio version (major.minor.patch) that counted the day.

activation.comment: project_found or no_project, for the most recent activation that day.

hasSemanticDir.comment: Whether the dbt project has an .erd-studio folder.

canvasOpens.comment: Diagrams opened that day, capped at 200.

stages.comment: Stages viewed, a subset of [logical, physical].

schemaFormats.comment: Domain file formats opened, a subset of [v5, v4].

manifest.comment: State of dbt's manifest.json when a diagram was opened: ok, missing, stale or unknown.

catalog.comment: Whether a dbt catalog.json was present.

errors.comment: Failure counts (0-100 each, zero keys omitted) keyed only by: manifestMissing (no longer recorded since 1.6.2), manifestMalformed, manifestTimeout, catalogUnreadable, domainLoad, modelFileParse, layersInvalid, editRejected, migrationFailed (a subject area or file naming migration failed in ERD Studio, not because of the user's folders or disk), other, and why a model file failed to parse, counted beside modelFileParse: modelFileRead, modelFileYamlIndent, modelFileYamlScalar, modelFileYamlStructure, modelFileYamlDuplicateKey, modelFileYamlOther; and failures on the getting-started paths: walkthroughFailed (the walkthrough could not open), drawFromDbtFailed, drawWriteFailed, addFromDbtFailed, layoutFailed (an auto layout failed) and firstLayoutFailed (the first-open layout of a new diagram failed), sampleCloneFailed, setupHarnessFailed, launcherInstallFailed, launcherRuntimeUnverified (VS Code's runtime could not run the checking tool), setupFailed, claudeOpenCommandMissing, claudeOpenFailed, copilotChatOpenFailed, welcomePanelFailed, projectPathInvalid (erdStudio.projectPath has no dbt_project.yml); Move Relationships to Model Library: relMoveDirtyFiles (refused because a file it would change had unsaved edits), relMoveWriteFailed (a write failed and every file was restored), relMoveFailed (the command failed); saveFailed (a diagram edit or Migrate to the New File Naming could not save a file), with why and where, counted beside it: saveFailedRefused (the editor refused the save, typically because the file changed on disk), saveFailedThrew (save() threw, typically a closed document), saveFailedReopen (re-opening the document to save it threw, typically a file system error), saveFailedModelFile (a model file was among the unsaved files), saveFailedRename (the duplicate-model rename could not save), saveFailedUndoRedo (an undo or redo could not save); relationships: relWriteFailed (a relationship edit could not be applied or saved), relHandlerFailed (a relationship edit failed unexpectedly), relSyncRefused (a model file's relationships list could not be rewritten in place, so the edit was refused), relMoveRestoreFailed (Move Relationships could not put every file back after a failed write); exportFailed (Export Diagram could not read the diagram or write the chosen file); importDbmlFailed (Import DBML… or Open Example Diagram, which shares its writer, failed while writing the new diagram); native DBML storage: why a .dbml table file failed to parse, counted beside modelFileParse: modelFileDbmlSyntax (a DBML syntax error or unresolved git conflict markers), modelFileDbmlInvalid (DBML rejects the file, e.g. an unquoted value), modelFileDbmlStructure (the file is not one self-contained Table); domainLoadDbml (a .dbml diagram could not be read as DBML, counted beside domainLoad); convertToDbmlFailed (Convert Project to DBML failed while writing); exampleWriteFailed (Open an Example Project could not write the example's files); importSqlDdlFailed (Import SQL DDL… failed: its SQL importer could not load, or converting or writing failed), importSemanticModelFailed (Import Semantic Model… failed while converting or writing); draftBuildFailed (building a draft preview failed), draftLayoutFailed (the draft preview's automatic layout failed and the fallback placement was drawn); dbtProfileWriteFailed (Parse without your credentials could not write its placeholder profile to ERD Studio's storage), dbtRunFailed (ERD Studio's own Run dbt parse or Run dbt compile code failed; never dbt's own failure); Added after 2.0.4, what a failed auto layout was like, counted beside layoutFailed (the canvas) or draftLayoutFailed (a draft page). Its kind, decided on the device from the error's type and the layout engine's own fixed wording, never by sending text: layoutFailedMemory (the engine ran out of memory, or asked for an array too long to allocate), layoutFailedUnsupported (the engine refused the layout options or the shape of the graph), layoutFailedInput (the engine refused the graph it was handed), layoutFailedEngine (another exception of the engine's own), layoutFailedResult (the result left a table without a usable position), layoutFailedOther (anything else). The diagram's size, as a range only and never a number: layoutFailedTablesUnder50, layoutFailedTables50to199, layoutFailedTables200to499, layoutFailedTables500Plus (tables); layoutFailedRelsUnder100, layoutFailedRels100to499, layoutFailedRels500to1999, layoutFailedRels2000Plus (relationships). How long it ran before failing: layoutFailedUnder1s, layoutFailed1to5s, layoutFailedOver5s. How far the fallbacks got: layoutFailedAllRungs (every fallback was tried and failed), with the kind of the last one's failure when that was layoutFailedLastRungTimeout (it ran out of time), layoutFailedLastRungWorker (the layout worker died) or layoutFailedLastRungMemory (it ran out of memory). Never messages or stack traces. Added after 2.0.4 (#304), why the host search for a dbt_project.yml failed, one counted beside each dbtSearchFailed: dbtSearchFailedRejected (VS Code's search refused it), dbtSearchFailedSort (reading or sorting the folders it returned threw), dbtSearchFailedThrew (the search threw before it started). Only which step failed, never a folder, a path or the error's message.

host.comment: The editor app, from a fixed list: vscode, vscodeInsiders, cursor, windsurf, vscodium, trae, kiro, positron, antigravity or other. The app's own name is never sent.

remote.comment: Where the extension runs: local, ssh, wsl, container, codespaces, web or other. Never a host name.

dev.comment: True when the day included an Extension Development Host or test run, or an install marked internal (the ERD_STUDIO_INTERNAL=1 environment variable on the author's own machines; there is no setting for it), so the author's own use can be left out.

assistants.comment: AI assistants found on the machine, a subset of [claude, copilot, codex, gemini, cursor]. Detected from installed VS Code extensions, the editor's name and command names on PATH; nothing is run.

harnesses.comment: ERD Studio AI harness files installed (version-marked) in the open project, a subset of [claude, agents, copilot, gemini, codex].

activeDays28.comment: On how many of the last 28 days ERD Studio activated, bucketed: 0, 1, 2-3, 4-7, 8-14, 15-28. Counted on the device; the dates are never sent.

canvasDays28.comment: On how many of the last 28 days a diagram was opened, same buckets. Counted on the device; the dates are never sent.

firstCanvas.comment: Days from first activation to the first diagram opened, bucketed like tenure, or never.

physicalTools.comment: How the open workspace builds its database tables, a subset of [dbt, sqlmesh, dataform, databricksBundle, fabric, powerBi, sqlProject, flyway, liquibase, alembic, prisma, django, rails, notebooks, ddlScripts, dbml], so the Physical stage can learn to read more than dbt. Looked for once a day, from file names and a fixed pattern at the start of a few small files (e.g. 'CREATE TABLE', a SQLMesh config key); nothing is run. Omitted when it was not looked for that day. Never a file name, path, count or content.

platforms.comment: The data platforms those tables live on, a subset of [databricks, snowflake, bigquery, postgres, redshift, fabric, synapse, sqlserver, duckdb, spark, trino, athena, mysql, oracle, clickhouse, other]: from dbt manifest.json's adapter_type, a dbt-<adapter> package in a requirements file, a SQL project's target, or a Databricks or Fabric marker file. dbt's profiles.yml, which holds credentials, is never read.

trail.comment: The onboarding trail, sent only for an install's first 7 days, the 7 days after a major ERD Studio update (such as 1.x to 2.x; never a minor or patch update) and on a day the Show Me Around guide runs (otherwise omitted): the day's events in the order they happened, at most 100, each [event, gap, window, repeat]; the last 10 places take only error codes and the windowClosed and canvasClosed markers. event is one of the fixed feature keys listed under features, an error code from errors written !code, or one of these markers: windowOpened (ERD Studio activated in a window), windowClosed (the window closed; best effort), windowAway / windowBack (the window lost and regained the focus, only when away 5 seconds or more), canvasOpened, canvasClosed, canvasHidden / canvasShown (a diagram went behind another tab and came back, 5 seconds or more), dayContinued (the first entry of a day whose window was activated on an earlier UTC day). gap is the whole seconds since the previous entry (0 for the first, at most 3600), window numbers the VS Code windows of that day 1, 2, ... in the order they joined the trail, and repeat folds the same event straight after (at most 100). Never a table, file or folder name, a path, a time of day or any text.

trailDropped.comment: With trail: how many events came after its 100 entries (counted only, at most 10000).

diagrams.comment: How often each diagram was opened and edited that day (omitted on a day none was): a list of [id, opens, edits], at most 30, plus one entry with id 0 that adds up any further diagrams. id is a random number from 1 to 65535 that ERD Studio made up for the diagram and keeps on this device; it is not made from the diagram's name, path or contents and is never a name, path, layer or table. It only says that two days' counts are for the same diagram. opens is canvas opens (at most 200), edits is edit requests made on its canvas (at most 1000). The number is forgotten after 90 days without use, and when telemetry is turned off.
